detail: Rights Issue — 5Paisa Capital Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on March 11, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 1 : 2, i.e 1 Equity Shares for every 2 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 300 per share.
